t: 一支由5,423名士兵组成的军队由何塞·德·圣马丁将军率领,从阿根廷穿越安第斯山脉,以解放智利…
te: An army of 5,423 soldiers, led by General José de San Martín, crosses the Andes from Argentina to liberate Chile and th…
dz: 一支由5,423名士兵组成的军队由何塞·德·圣马丁将军率领,从阿根廷穿越安第斯山脉,以解放智利,再解放秘鲁.
de: An army of 5,423 soldiers, led by General José de San Martín, crosses the Andes from Argentina to liberate Chile and then Peru.

t: 胡安·格雷戈里奥·德拉斯·赫拉斯(Juan Gregorio de las Heras)的许多…
te: Many soldiers of Juan Gregorio de las Heras are captured during the action of Picheuta.
dz: 穿越安第斯山脉:胡安·格雷戈里奥·德拉斯·赫拉斯(Juan Gregorio de las Heras)的许多士兵在皮克乌塔的行动中被俘.
de: Crossing of the Andes: Many soldiers of Juan Gregorio de las Heras are captured during the action of Picheuta.

t: 一支由拉斯·赫拉斯大元帅率领的军队穿越安第斯山脉,与圣马丁会合,从西班牙解放了智利.
te: An army led by Grand Marshal Las Heras crosses the Andes to join San Martín in the liberation of Chile from Spain.
dz: 一支由拉斯·赫拉斯大元帅率领的军队穿越安第斯山脉,与圣马丁会合,从西班牙解放了智利.
de: An army led by Grand Marshal Las Heras crosses the Andes to join San Martín in the liberation of Chile from Spain.

t: 阿根廷/智利爱国军队在穿越安第斯山脉后,在查卡布克战役中击败了西班牙军队.
te: An Argentine/Chilean patriotic army, after crossing the Andes, defeats Spanish troops at the Battle of Chacabuco.
dz: 阿根廷/智利爱国军队在穿越安第斯山脉后,在查卡布克战役中击败了西班牙军队.
de: An Argentine/Chilean patriotic army, after crossing the Andes, defeats Spanish troops at the Battle of Chacabuco.

t: 托马斯·霍普金斯·加尔劳代特和洛朗·克勒克(英语:Laurent Clerc)在康涅狄格州哈特…
te: Thomas Hopkins Gallaudet and Laurent Clerc found the American School for the Deaf (then called the Connecticut Asylum f…
dz: 托马斯·霍普金斯·加尔劳代特和洛朗·克勒克(英语:Laurent Clerc)在康涅狄格州哈特福德发现了美国聋人学校(当时称为康涅狄格聋人教育和指导庇护所),这是美国第一所聋人学生学校.
de: Thomas Hopkins Gallaudet and Laurent Clerc found the American School for the Deaf (then called the Connecticut Asylum for the Education and Instruction of Deaf and Dumb Persons), the first American school for deaf students, in Hartford, Connecticut.

t: 第一艘"大湖"蒸汽机"Frontenac"被推出.
te: The first Great Lakes steamer, the Frontenac, is launched.
dz: 第一艘"大湖"蒸汽机"Frontenac"被推出.
de: The first Great Lakes steamer, the Frontenac, is launched.

t: 最早的自行车形式是"andy马"由卡尔·冯·德赖斯驾驶.
te: The earliest form of bicycle, the dandy horse, is driven by Karl von Drais.
dz: 最早的自行车形式是"andy马"由卡尔·冯·德赖斯驾驶.
de: The earliest form of bicycle, the dandy horse, is driven by Karl von Drais.

t: 在纽约罗马,伊利运河上开始建造.
te: In Rome, New York, construction on the Erie Canal begins.
dz: 在纽约罗马,伊利运河上开始建造.
de: In Rome, New York, construction on the Erie Canal begins.

t: 格奥尔格·安东·舍费尔(英语:Georg Anton Schäffer)在试图为俄美公司征服哈…
te: Unsuccessful in his attempt to conquer the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi for the Russian-American Company, Georg Anton Schäffer is…
dz: 格奥尔格·安东·舍费尔(英语:Georg Anton Schäffer)在试图为俄美公司征服哈瓦伊王国时未能成功,被迫承认战败并离开克瓦伊.
de: Unsuccessful in his attempt to conquer the Kingdom of Hawaiʻi for the Russian-American Company, Georg Anton Schäffer is forced to admit defeat and leave Kauaʻi.

t: 意大利探险家和考古学家乔瓦尼·贝尔佐尼(Giovanni Belzoni)在国王之谷发现了塞蒂…
te: Italian explorer and archaeologist Giovanni Belzoni, uncovered the Tomb of Seti I in the Valley of the Kings.
dz: 意大利探险家和考古学家乔瓦尼·贝尔佐尼(Giovanni Belzoni)在国王之谷发现了塞蒂一世墓.
de: Italian explorer and archaeologist Giovanni Belzoni, uncovered the Tomb of Seti I in the Valley of the Kings.

t: 西蒙·玻利瓦尔因挑战委内瑞拉的种族种姓而判处曼努埃尔·皮阿尔死刑.
te: Simón Bolívar sentences Manuel Piar to death for challenging the racial-caste in Venezuela.
dz: 西蒙·玻利瓦尔因挑战委内瑞拉的种族种姓而判处曼努埃尔·皮阿尔死刑.
de: Simón Bolívar sentences Manuel Piar to death for challenging the racial-caste in Venezuela.

t: 西蒙·玻利瓦尔就任委内瑞拉第三共和国总统。
te: Simón Bolívar becomes President of the Third Republic of Venezuela.
dz: 西蒙·玻利瓦尔就任委内瑞拉第三共和国总统。
de: Simón Bolívar becomes President of the Third Republic of Venezuela.

t: 加拿大最古老的特许银行蒙特利尔银行在蒙特利尔开业.
te: The Bank of Montreal, Canada's oldest chartered bank, opens in Montreal.
dz: 加拿大最古老的特许银行蒙特利尔银行在蒙特利尔开业.
de: The Bank of Montreal, Canada's oldest chartered bank, opens in Montreal.

t: 密西西比州成为美国第 20 个州。
dz: 密西西比州成为美国第 20 个州。
